title: Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train?
caption: Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train? Three trains. Best of three. One of them never showed up. 🚄⚽ Don't try this with any train. #could #ronaldo #cr7 #siuuu #physics #deutschebahn #whatif #fyp

scenes.text: Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train? {{ev}}We tested it. {{three}}Three trains. {{rounds}}Three rounds. ||0.2|| {{score}}Best of three.

The challenger: {{name}}Cristiano Ronaldo. {{h}}{1.87|One point eight seven} metres of Portuguese forward. {{hdr}}In {2019|twenty nineteen}, he headed a ball at a height of {2.56|two point five six} metres. {{siu}}He lands every jump with the same word. {{word}}Siuuu.

Round one. {{name}}A German high speed train. {{h}}{3.89|Three point eight nine} metres tall. {{v}}Three hundred kilometres per hour. {{need}}To clear the roof, his feet must pass almost four metres. {{has}}His famous header lifted them seventy centimetres. {{short}}Three metres short. ||0.3|| {{slow}}The train does not slow down for legends. {{score}}Round one: the train.

Round two. {{name}}An Intercity. {{v}}Only two hundred kilometres per hour. {{ready}}Ronaldo is ready. ||0.3|| {{db}}But in {2025|twenty twenty five}, only sixty percent of German long distance trains arrived on time. {{wait}}So he waits. ||0.3|| {{again}}And waits. {{cancel}}Then the train is cancelled. ||0.4|| {{logic}}A train that never arrives cannot hit you. {{score}}Round two: Ronaldo.

The deciding round. {{name}}A model train. {{scale}}Scale one to eighty seven. {{h}}Four and a half centimetres tall. {{v}}Scale speed: three hundred kilometres per hour. {{real}}Real speed: one metre per second. {{has}}His jump: seventy centimetres. ||0.3|| {{go}}Ronaldo gets into position. {{jump}}He jumps. ||0.6|| {{clear}}Sixty five centimetres to spare. {{score}}Round three, and the match: Ronaldo.
One more thing. {{late}}The model train was three minutes late. ||0.3|| {{why}}It was made in Germany.

The verdict. {{q}}Could Cristiano Ronaldo jump high enough to dodge a moving train? ||0.5|| {{yes}}Yes. ||0.4|| {{small}}If the train is small enough. ||0.2|| {{late}}Or late enough. {{p1}}Final score: Ronaldo two, trains one. ||0.3|| {{siu}}Siuuu. ||0.3|| {{safe}}Please do not try this. With any train. Not even a small one.
